evidence_digest:
edit src/coop/net_bridge.c | symbol=ProcessInboundMessage, pattern=newer same-epoch SESSION_READY only advances rx_sequence and returns FALSE; why=the live generation cutover must reset presence/queues before lifecycle traffic, preserve queued-save semantics, and emit ROM_READY; this control flow cannot be corrected additively outside the hub
edit src/coop/presence_runtime.c | symbol=EnsureRemoteRenderer/TryInteract/Update, pattern=StartSpriteAnimInDirection is unconditional and TryInteract gates only reducer visibility without fresh owned renderer/effective pose/staleness checks; why=central runtime logic must prevent animation rewinds, deny stale/hidden/unowned interaction, enforce effective visibility, and preserve deterministic interpolation/snap behavior
edit src/event_object_movement.c | symbol=SpawnObjectEventsOnReturnToField, pattern=active remote ObjectEvents are excluded before SpawnObjectEventOnReturnToField; why=return-to-field sprite reset currently strands active remote objects as unsprited orphans, while existing real-object lookup and collision exclusions should remain unchanged
edit src/field_control_avatar.c | symbol=ProcessPlayerFieldInput, pattern=pressed-A TryInteract runs before TryStartInteractionScript; why=remote interaction currently masks actionable overlapping real-object and field-script interactions, so vanilla precedence must run first and remote consumption remain the sole fallback
edit test/coop/net_bridge.c | symbol=outer-sequence regression, pattern=malformed spawn sequence 2 is followed by same-epoch SESSION_READY sequence 2 expecting ROM_READY; why=the regression must exercise the repaired live same-epoch cutover and prove malformed outer traffic cannot block the accepted lifecycle
edit test/coop/presence_runtime.c | symbol=runtime test suite, pattern=only four reducer/queue tests exist and no direct Update/TryInteract/AdvanceFrame/OnWarpCommit coverage; why=add deterministic runtime coverage for renderer recreation/ownership, six-frame interpolation and snap, animation progression, stale/hidden visibility, interaction queue-full behavior, warp/return fencing, and local-link isolation
dependency include/coop/presence_runtime.h | existing public Init/Update/TryInteract/AdvanceFrame/OnWarpCommit/IsRemoteObject seams cover the correction; no new API is required because renderer validation remains internal and return recreation uses the existing event loop
dependency src/overworld.c | ApplyCurrentWarp already calls OnWarpCommit and CB1_Overworld updates presence before input; existing return flow reaches SpawnObjectEventsOnReturnToField, so no edit is required here
dependency dist/bridge_manifest.json | unchanged ABI/protocol/message sizes and queue constants match the frozen contract; corrections are behavior-only, so regeneration should verify this manifest remains unchanged
